detail.longDescription: SpecterOps currently has 3 free on-demand courses in its Tradecraft Academy, including Kubernetes for Red Teamers. It is a solid intro to attacking Kubernetes and gives you a structured way of looking at a cluster from an adversarial perspective. The labs also use Mythic for C2, so you get some exposure to that along the way. I also patched the lab to run on KVM/libvirt instead of VirtualBox: https:// github.com/GregDurys/specterop s-k8s-red-teamers-libvirt-patch # RedTeam # Kubernetes # Mythic
